svg.title: Gauge Steps
svg.desc: North-up layout and numbered route key. 1. Gauge Steps. 2. Dry upper verge. 3. Pale slab. 4. Drowned burrow. 5. Reed fence gap. 6. Level board. 7. Quilt hatch.
svg.text: Orren detail · the two berths at the opening tide
Split survey cut at stair foot
Sidestep north out of the furrow
First scout rushes west on shelf
Clear the line into the beds
Ramp post above the cart ruts
North up · Routes and footprints at blockout scale
